#Testing ID number merge: 

```{r}
library(dplyr)
merged <- full_join(Medicare_Survey, Winter_file, by = "PUF_ID")

n_common <- length(intersect(Medicare_Survey$PUF_ID, Winter_file$PUF_ID))
cat("Common IDs:", n_common, "\n")

write.csv(merged, "merged.csv")

```
